text: Warm diagnostic v2 failed closed on dense WL/GraKeL because the runner reclassified a batch from the later timed median, contradicting ADR-008's one untimed process-local calibration contract. Repair records calibration_ns in every worker result and receipt, validates batch_size directly from that calibration, retains the independent 30 s timed-work gate, and adds a regression where 99 ms calibration selects batch 2 despite a later 125 ms normalized median. Verified: court 20/20, GraKeL 4/4, JVM worker 15/15 plus assembly, Julia worker suite, Ruff, scalafmt, and git diff check.
